Chachamaru represented the Green Dragon Society inside Rokuhara; Professor Wolf did the same inside GHQ. Both sides, proper representation.

en.html:
Wolf"So... the appointment ceremony's date is now fixed."
Wolf"And Silver Star wakes the day before it? You are certain?"
Chachamaru"Pakka."
Kageaki"How do you know?"
Chachamaru"Apun's special power. Can sense the structure and condition inside people and things."
Chachamaru"Give the diagnosis enough time, and accuracy is almost a hundred percent."
Kageaki"...Why do you have such an ability?"
Chachamaru"A young lady's secret☆"
Wolf"How embarrassing you are..."
Chachamaru"Arre, from YOU, that actually makes apun feel embarrassed! Should've kept my bloody mouth shut!"
Wolf"Still, this is troublesome. One day out of alignment?"
Chachamaru"Don't be so demanding, yaar. These things were never going to match perfectly by themselves. Our comrades in Kyoto worked like mad to get it anywhere near what we asked."
Chachamaru"Only one day's gap between the ceremony and our Princess waking up? That's good work, bhai."
Wolf"True. Well... one day early, perhaps we can manage?"
Wolf"Lieutenant Colonel Cannon seems to be planning his operation for the day of the ceremony, or the day after. I'll find a good reason and somehow talk him around."
Chachamaru"Go on, then. Best of luck."
Wolf"Very easily you say that. Do you have any idea how difficult it is to fool Lieutenant Colonel Cannon with words?"
Chachamaru"No idea."
Wolf"Bas. Now I am angry. Tie those shoelaces properly! DOUBLE KNOT!"
Chachamaru"Not taking knot orders from you."
Wolf"Minato!"
Kageaki"Tie your shoelaces, Chachamaru."
Chachamaru"Eh... BHAI, YOU TOO?!"

ja.html:
ウォルフ「で…… 　宣下式典の日取りが決まり」
ウォルフ「銀星号が目覚めるのは、その前日？ 　間違いないのかね」
茶々丸「確実」
景明「どうしてわかる？」
茶々丸「あての特殊能力スペシャルパワー。 　人や物の内部構造や状態を感知・・できます」
茶々丸「時間を掛けて診断すれば、精度はほとんど 一〇〇％」
景明「……何故、そんな能力が」
茶々丸「乙女のヒミツ☆」
ウォルフ「恥ずかしいやつだな……君は……」
茶々丸「うわ、おめーに言われるとなんかほんとに 恥ずかしいよ！ 　言うんじゃなかった！」
ウォルフ「しかし困ったな。 　一日ずれているのか」
茶々丸「贅沢言うなよ。こんなもん、本当なら丁度 良く合うわけないんだから。 　京都の同志なかまが頑張って、どーにかこーにか こっちの要求に近付けてくれたんだ」
茶々丸「宣下式典と銀星号おひめの覚醒、ずれが一日だけ で済んだのは上出来だろ」
ウォルフ「確かにね。 　まぁ、一日早いくらいなら、どうにかなる かな？」
ウォルフ「キャノン中佐は式典の当日、ないし翌日の 作戦決行を考えているみたいだが……何とか 言いくるめよう。 　うまい理由を探してね」
茶々丸「頑張れよ」
ウォルフ「あっさり言ってくれるな君は。 　キャノン中佐を口先で誤魔化すのが、どの くらい大変だと思ってるんだ」
茶々丸「知らねー」
ウォルフ「ムカ。怒った。 　パンツ脱げ！」
茶々丸「脱がねーよ」
ウォルフ「湊斗君！」
景明「脱げ。茶々丸」
茶々丸「えっ……えーーー!?」

Wolf"By herself she is completely harmless. No need to worry."
Kageaki"Bomb?"
Wolf"This one."

Chachamaru"Half human—Judean. The other half is a kind of machine."
Wolf"She brings about the decay of Plutonianoa, the underworld ore. And then... everything is destroyed."
Wolf"The Forged Bomb. In human history, no greater destructive force has ever been available."
Kageaki"...And what do you plan to do with it?"
Chachamaru"The day before the ceremony. A raiding force led by GHQ's Lieutenant Colonel Cannon comes over Fudaraku."
Chachamaru"Drops this Forged Bomb. All Rokuhara's forces gathered for the ceremony, wiped out in one blow. Then control of Yamato is theirs."
Chachamaru"But the real purpose—our Green Dragon Society's purpose—is something else."
Kageaki"..."
Wolf"We shall bring the Forged Bomb and Silver Star together."
Wolf"Destruction joined to destruction, my friend."
Kageaki"...What?!"
Kageaki"If you do that—"

Chachamaru"But do nothing, and Hikaru Minato dies for certain."
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"This is the only chance."
Chachamaru"The Forged Bomb and Silver Star. One extreme multiplied by the other, to get through that hundred-fifteen-kilometre barrier."
Chachamaru"Cut open the road to God."
Kageaki"...Can it be done?"
Kageaki"Can that really be done?"
Wolf"There is a possibility."

Wolf"The possibility IS THERE!"

Wolf"What about you? Will you stop here?"
Wolf"Give up on Hikaru Minato's life?"

　お兄さんがいま危惧した通り、御姫が吹っ
飛んで終わりって可能性もある」茶々丸「……むしろ……そうなる見込みの方が強い
のかもしれない」景明「茶々丸――」茶々丸「でも何もしなければ、湊斗光は確実に死ぬ」景明「…………」茶々丸「唯一の可能性なんだ」茶々丸「鍛造雷弾と銀星号。
　極限と極限を掛け合わせて一一五キロの壁
を越える」茶々丸「神への道を切り開く」景明「…………できるのか？」景明「本当に、それはできる事なのか？」ウォルフ「可能性はある」ウォルフ「湊斗光が神に至る可能性。
　我々が神に出会う可能性」ウォルフ「可能性はある!!」景明「…………」ウォルフ「僕は挑むよ。
　茶々丸もだ」ウォルフ「君はどうする？
　やめるかね？」ウォルフ「湊斗光の生命を、諦めるかね？」景明「――――」景明「諦められる……わけが、あるか」

en.html:
Choice? There was no choice here.

However uncertain the chance. Even if a spider's thread would be sturdier than it. If that alone could save Hikaru—

Then everything went on the stake. Everything could be sacrificed. I would seize that chance.

あろうとも。
